CustomObject.description:
A decision criterion, OURS. The subject of a criteria answer, per addendum 20.
WHY THIS IS OURS AND NOT ALTF__Decision_Criteria__c, which is the obvious reading of "the fifth subject type" and is unbuildable. LAW #1: the system runs with Altify absent, so a subject lookup at a managed object would make the entire criteria path require a package we are forbidden to depend on. And "Where the truth lives": claims land on our objects first and Altify receives a projection, so a subject that IS the Altify row inverts the write order - the criterion would have to exist in their org before we could write the claim that establishes it. Architecture v2.1 adopted criteria "adding a fifth Claim subject type and no new entity"; that sentence was written when the subject was assumed to be the vendor row, and it does not survive LAW #1. One entity is the price.
The vendor row is the PROJECTION of this one, and AAO_Projected_Criterion_Id__c is where that lands.
CustomObject.label: AAO Criterion
